CLAIM-001.reason: EXP-0002 confirms MFT-First > Carving across all 4 seeds. MFT-First OU range: [0.958900, 0.998300]. Carving OU range: [0.000000, 0.008000]. The advantage is robust to dataset composition. NEW FINDING: Carving is NOT always OU=0 on healthy images — it sometimes recovers a tiny amount (0.0028-0.0080). This is a genuine observation, not a failure.
CLAIM-001.next_step: EXP-0003: cross-machine reproduction to reach REPRODUCIBLE

CLAIM-002.reason: EXP-0002 does not directly test functional recovery granularity. Requires corruption experiments to see partial recovery.

CLAIM-005.reason: EXP-0002 confirms determinism across 4 different seeds. Hash identical within each seed group. Parser reliability is not seed-dependent.

ED-001_umbral_empirico.evidence: Cross-seed MFT-First OU CV = 2.2977%, MFT-First > Carving across all seeds = True
ED-001_umbral_empirico.note: ED-001 requires cross-machine validation (EXP-0003) to reach PAGADA.

ED-008_variabilidad_desconocida.evidence: Deterministic per seed = True, cross-seed OU SD = 0.022491

carving_not_always_zero.description: Carving is NOT always OU=0 on healthy NTFS images. It sometimes recovers a tiny amount (0.0028-0.0080). This varies by seed/dataset composition.
carving_not_always_zero.implication: The floor measurement for Carving is not exactly zero. This means CLAIM-001's margin is slightly smaller than previously estimated, but still overwhelmingly large.
